name: @guerillaglass/desktop-electrobun
description: Guerillaglass desktop shell built with Electrobun + React + Tailwind

scripts.start: bun run electrobun:sync && bun run native:build:macos && bun run i18n:compile && vite build && launchctl setenv GG_ENGINE_PATH "$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.build/debug/guerillaglass-engine" && GG_ASSUME_MACOS_NATIVE_PRODUCTS_BUILT=1 electrobun dev
scripts.dev: bun run electrobun:sync && bun run native:build:macos && bun run i18n:compile && vite build && launchctl setenv GG_ENGINE_PATH "$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.build/debug/guerillaglass-engine" && GG_ASSUME_MACOS_NATIVE_PRODUCTS_BUILT=1 electrobun dev --watch
scripts.start:diagnostics: sh -c 'launchctl setenv GG_DEBUG 1; trap "launchctl unsetenv GG_DEBUG" EXIT; bun run dev:hmr'
scripts.build: bun run electrobun:sync && bun run i18n:compile && vite build && electrobun build
scripts.build:prod: bun run electrobun:sync && bun run i18n:compile && vite build && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.typecheck: bun run electrobun:sync && bun run i18n:compile && bun run typecheck:ci
scripts.test: bun run i18n:compile && bun run test:ci
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:vitest:ci -- --run && bun run test:ui:ci -- --run
scripts.test:ui: bun run i18n:compile && bun run test:ui:ci
scripts.test:ui:headed: bun run i18n:compile && bun run test:ui:ci -- --browser.headless false
scripts.test:vitest: bun run i18n:compile && bun run test:vitest:ci
scripts.native:build:macos: cd ../.. && swift build --product guerillaglass-engine && swift build -c release --product guerillaglass-code-signature-checker
scripts.native:build:macos:release: cd ../.. && swift build -c release --product guerillaglass-engine && swift build -c release --product guerillaglass-code-signature-checker
